---
title: "Common Errors"
---

## `adk: command not found`

| Likely Cause | Suggested Action |
| --- | --- |
| The virtual environment is inactive. | Activate it again using the command for your operating system. |
| `adk` was installed outside the environment. | Reinstall ADK while the environment is active. |

<div class="cmd-explain">Activate the environment on macOS:</div>
```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
```

<div class="cmd-explain">Reactivate the environment on Windows:</div>
```powershell
.\\.venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1
```

<div class="cmd-explain">Reinstall ADK in the active environment if needed:</div>
```bash
python -m pip install google-adk
```

## `python3.11: command not found` (macOS)

| Likely Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| The installer was not run or Terminal is still using the old session. | Quit Terminal, reopen it, and rerun `python3.11 --version`. |
| PATH is missing `/usr/local/bin`. | Add `export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"` to `~/.zprofile`, then `source ~/.zprofile`. |

<div class="cmd-explain">Add `/usr/local/bin` to the PATH if needed:</div>
```bash
echo 'export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zprofile
```

<div class="cmd-explain">Reload the profile to apply the change:</div>
```bash
source ~/.zprofile
```

## `pip` Points to Another Python (Windows)

| Likely Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| Another Python version is earlier in PATH. | Use the interpreter to drive `pip` explicitly. |

<div class="cmd-explain">Invoke `pip` through Python 3.11:</div>
```powershell
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
```

## TLS/SSL Errors During `pip install`

| Likely Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| Corporate SSL inspection or outdated certificates. | Install certificates bundled with Python. |

<div class="cmd-explain">Run the certificate installation script (macOS):</div>
```bash
"/Applications/Python 3.11/Install Certificates.command"
```

<div class="cmd-explain">Run the certificate installation script (Windows):</div>
```powershell
& "C:\Program Files\Python311\Install Certificates.command"
```

If the command path differs, open the Python installation folder and double-click the script manually.

## `ModuleNotFoundError` After Activating the Environment

| Likely Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| Required package not installed in `.venv`. | Install the package while the environment is active. |

<div class="cmd-explain">Install a missing package (example for `google-adk`):</div>
```bash
pip install google-adk
```

::: {.callout-tip}
If you discover a new issue, add it to this chapter with the exact command and output. A future you (or teammate) will thank you.
:::
